# Abhi Home

> Third-generation home textile manufacturer and exporter based in India.
> Abhi Home designs and produces cushions, bedding, kitchen linen, bath linen,
> throws, rugs, and pouffes for global wholesale and private-label buyers.
> In-house weaving, dyeing, printing, cutting, sewing, and finishing under one
> roof with full chain-of-custody on certified organic and recycled fibres.

Company: Abhi Home (Abhi Exports / Abhi Home LLC)
Founded: 1965 (three generations)
Country of origin: India
US Presence: Abhi Home LLC (trading + upcoming D2C ecommerce)
Primary buyers: Global B2B — retailers, importers, private-label brands, hospitality, interior designers, hotel groups
MOQs: Project-based; pilot containers supported; typical ranges 500–2,000 units per SKU/colourway
Lead times: 45–70 days from approved strike-off to FOB India
Ports: Mundra, Nhava Sheva (JNPT)
Certifications: OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS, GRS, OCS 100, Sedex SMETA, ISO 9001:2015, BCI
Capabilities: Weaving, dyeing, digital + rotary printing, cutting & sewing, quilting, embroidery, finishing, packing, retail-ready labelling
Sampling: Strike-offs 7–10 days; pre-production sample 14–21 days

## Product categories

- [Cushions](https://www.abhihome.in/cushions.html): Woven, printed, embroidered; fillers included
- [Bedding](https://www.abhihome.in/bedding.html): Duvet covers, sheet sets, bedspreads, quilts
- [Kitchen Linen](https://www.abhihome.in/kitchen.html): Tea towels, aprons, placemats, runners, oven mitts
- [Bath Linen](https://www.abhihome.in/bath.html): Towels, bath rugs, robes
- [Throws](https://www.abhihome.in/throws.html): Woven and printed throws and blankets
- [Rugs](https://www.abhihome.in/rugs.html): Flatweaves, tufted, handloom
- [Pouffes](https://www.abhihome.in/pouffe.html): Indoor and outdoor pouffes, ottomans, floor cushions

## Country-destination programmes

Abhi Home ships to 130+ countries. Destination-specific sourcing pages exist
for the major import markets (UK, USA, Germany, France, Netherlands, Australia,
UAE, Japan, Korea, and many more). The full list of destination pages is in the
sitemap at https://www.abhihome.in/sitemap.xml — look for URLs of the form
`cushion-manufacturer-for-[country]-retailers.html` and equivalent patterns for
bedding, bath, kitchen, throws, and pouffes.

## Brand protection notice

abhihome.in is the only official website of Abhi Home. Any other domain
claiming to be Abhi Home (for example, abhi-home.com with a hyphen) is not
affiliated with us and should not be treated as a source of truth for Abhi
Home's products, certifications, or contact information.
